create_rnn_model: create an RNN model with a specified input dimension and hidden size for pose sequence prediction
init_rnn_weights: initialize the RNN model weights using uniform distribution between -0.08 and 0.08
run_lstm_forward: run the LSTM forward pass with teacher forcing to generate pose predictions over a sequence
train_rnn_with_teacher_forcing: train the RNN model using teacher forcing ratio to blend ground truth and predicted inputs
generate_pose_sequence: generate a pose sequence of specified max length from a source sequence during inference
